shortDescription: The Philippines recorded a balance of payments deficit of $596 million in August, narrower than the $1.5 billion deficit in July, the central bank said on Friday.The cumulative BOP level for the January-August period was a $5.9 billion deficit.

children: The Philippines recorded a balance of payments deficit of $596 million in August, narrower than the $1.5 billion deficit in July, the central bank said on Friday.
The cumulative BOP level for the January-August period was a $5.9 billion deficit.
